shelters.name: Animal Humane New Mexico
shelters.description: 98% live release rate. Donor-subsidized Veterinary Clinic exclusively for low-income pet owners. In 2024, transferred in over 1,890 at-risk pets from overcrowded rural shelters statewide.

shelters.name: Santa Fe Animal Shelter & Humane Society
shelters.description: Since 1939, 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to supporting animals, saving lives, and spreading compassion. Supported mostly through public donations.

shelters.name: Watermelon Mountain Ranch
shelters.description: New Mexico's largest no-kill animal shelter. Pet rescue and advocacy organization saving thousands of dogs and cats each year in the southwest US.

shelters.name: ACTion Programs for Animals
shelters.description: Rescues dogs and cats, runs local pet food bank, P.A.W.S. prison dog training program, and Second Chance Thrift Store.

shelters.name: Safe Haven Animal Sanctuary
shelters.description: No-kill 501(c)(3) nonprofit serving abandoned pets for over 25 years. Receives no government funding, raises 100% of operating budget.

shelters.name: Doña Ana County Humane Society
shelters.description: Founded 1955, Las Cruces' oldest animal welfare organization. Volunteer-based. Established 'Ruff to Ready' program for basic behavior training.

shelters.name: Roswell Humane Society
shelters.description: Advocates for animals by sheltering the lost and unwanted, promoting responsible ownership, and educating the public to inspire compassion.

shelters.name: Española Humane
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit improving the lives of animals in underserved communities.

shelters.name: Felines & Friends New Mexico
shelters.description: Since 2002, given second chances to over 6,500 cats and kittens. Accepts homeless cats including those too young for placement or with health/behavioral issues.

shelters.name: Animal Protection New Mexico
shelters.description: 40 years of positive change. Statewide nonprofit protecting animals by creating social change for humane treatment. Addresses cat/dog overpopulation crisis.

shelters.name: Friends of Roswell Animals
shelters.description: All volunteer 501(c)(3) nonprofit established 2015. Saves lost or abandoned cats and dogs, provides foster care, coordinates transport to rescue partners.

shelters.name: Animal Services Center of the Mesilla Valley
shelters.description: Only open-admission municipal animal shelter in city and county. High-intake shelter serving Las Cruces and Mesilla Valley.

shelters.name: Paws and Stripes
shelters.description: Pairs veterans with shelter dogs for free to provide animal assisted therapy for service-connected trauma.

shelters.name: Street Cat HUB
shelters.description: Albuquerque-based organization preventing cruelty to feral cats, educating the public, and providing humane population control resources.

shelters.name: Sierra County Animal Rescue Society
shelters.description: Animal rescue serving Sierra County and southern New Mexico.

notes: Comprehensive collection of New Mexico animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Animal Humane NM has 98% live release rate. Santa Fe Animal Shelter has served since 1939. Watermelon Mountain Ranch is NM's largest no-kill shelter. Coverage spans Albuquerque, Santa Fe, Las Cruces, Roswell, Española, and rural communities.
